notes.title: Achievements Part 2 - Horse Game
notes.content: 5 new achievements have been added! These are all incredibly challenging tasks related to The Horse Game, one of the games inside of this game, a game in which YOU, yes you, find the horse.

notes.title: Achievements Part 1 Live! Plus, Linux/Deck support
notes.content:
The first set of achievements are live! This is a set of ten, all connected to the arcade zone proper. Later, additional achievements will be added for each individual game.

On top of that, a native Linux build has been uploaded and the game should now run properly on the Steam Deck! Please let me know if you run into any issues. Thank you, my friends.

notes.title: Achievements coming soon!
notes.content:
A full achievement set will be added soon as well as Linux and Steam Deck support!

The first achievement (Welcome to the Machine) was a test, but I'm leaving it live because a couple players have already earned it. More soon!
